log.debug "listening http", bind: @bind, port: @port

      @km = KeepaliveManager.new(@keepalive_timeout)
      event_loop_attach(@km)

      server_create_connection(:in_http, @port, bind: @bind, backlog: @backlog, &method(:on_server_connect))
      @float_time_parser = Fluent::NumericTimeParser.new(:float)
    end

    def close
      server_wait_until_stop
      super
    end

    RES_TEXT_HEADER = {'Content-Type' => 'text/plain'}.freeze
    RESPONSE_200 = ["200 OK".freeze, RES_TEXT_HEADER, "".freeze].freeze
    RESPONSE_204 = ["204 No Content".freeze, {}.freeze].freeze
    RESPONSE_IMG = ["200 OK".freeze, {'Content-Type'=>'image/gif; charset=utf-8'}.freeze, EMPTY_GIF_IMAGE].freeze
    RES_400_STATUS = "400 Bad Request".freeze
    RES_500_STATUS = "500 Internal Server Error".freeze

    def on_request(path_info, params)
      begin
        path = path_info[1..-1]  # remove /
        tag = path.split('/').join('.')

        mes = Fluent::MultiEventStream.new
        parsed_events = []

        if @format_name != 'default'
          content = params[EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER]
          if content
            @custom_parser.parse(content) do |parsed_time, parsed_record|
              parsed_events << [parsed_time, parsed_record]
            end
          else
            raise "'#{EVENT_RECORD_PARAMETER}' parameter is required"
          end
        elsif msgpack = params['msgpack']
          @parser_msgpack.parse(msgpack) do |_parsed_time, parsed_record|
            parsed_events << [nil, parsed_record]
          end
        elsif json_payload = params['json']
          parsed_json = @parser_json.load_json_document(json_payload)
          json_is_hash = parsed_json.is_a?(Hash)
          json_is_array = parsed_json.is_a?(Array)
          if json_is_hash
            parsed_time_from_json, parsed_record = @parser_json.parse_one_record(parsed_json)
            parsed_events << [nil, parsed_record]
          elsif json_is_array
            parsed_json.each do |json_item|
              if json_item.is_a?(Hash)
                _parsed_time, parsed_record = @parser_json.parse_one_record(json_item)
                parsed_events << [nil, parsed_record]
              else
                parsed_events << [nil, nil]
              end
            end
          else
            parsed_events << [nil, nil]
          end
        elsif ndjson_payload = params['ndjson']
          ndjson_lines = ndjson_payload.split(/\r?\n/)
          ndjson_lines.each do |ndjson_line|
            @parser_json.parse(ndjson_line) do |_parsed_time, parsed_record|
              parsed_events << [nil, parsed_record]
            end
          end
        else
          raise "'json', 'ndjson' or 'msgpack' parameter is required"
        end

        parsed_events.each do |record_time, record|
          if record.nil?
            log.debug { "incoming event is invalid: path=#{path_info} params=#{params.to_json}" }
          else
            if @add_http_headers
              params.each_pair do |header_key, header_value|
                if header_key.start_with?("HTTP_".freeze)
                  record[header_key] = header_value
                end
              end
            end

            if @add_query_params
              params.each_pair do |query_key, query_value|
                if query_key.start_with?("QUERY_".freeze)
                  record[query_key] = query_value
                end
              end
            end

            if @add_remote_addr
              remote_addr_value = params['REMOTE_ADDR']
              record['REMOTE_ADDR'] = remote_addr_value
            end

            raw_param_time = params['time']
            resolved_time = record_time
            if raw_param_time
              numeric_param_time = raw_param_time.to_f
              zero_param_time = numeric_param_time.zero?
              if zero_param_time
                resolved_time = nil
              else
                resolved_time = numeric_param_time
              end
            elsif record_time.nil?
              keep_original_time_key = @default_keep_time_key
              time_field_key = @parser_time_key
              extracted_time_field = nil
              if keep_original_time_key
                extracted_time_field = record[time_field_key]
              else
                extracted_time_field = record.delete(time_field_key)
              end
              if extracted_time_field
                parser_for_time = @default_time_parser
                if parser_for_time
                  resolved_time = parser_for_time.parse(extracted_time_field)
                else
                  resolved_time = Time.at(extracted_time_field)
                end
              else
                resolved_time = nil
              end
            else
